cards.front: Sé que si hubieras seguido insistiendo, él habría terminado el informe antes de la reunión.
cards.back: I know that if you'd kept on at him, he would have finished the report before the meeting.

cards.front: Cuanto más insistas, más trabajará él.
cards.back: The more you keep on at him, the more he'll work.

cards.front: Por mucho que insistas con Sandra, no seguirá tus consejos.
cards.back: No matter how much you keep on at Sandra, she won't follow your advice.

cards.front: Él lleva todo el día dándome la paliza porque no termino con Alex. ¿Por qué no me deja en paz?
cards.back: He's been giving me grief all day because I won't finish with Alex. Why can't he get off my back?

cards.front: Sé que no debería haberme ido sin despedirme, pero por favor, no me des la paliza.
cards.back: I know I shouldn't have left without saying goodbye, but please don't give me so much grief.

cards.front: Mi amigo Kevin me está dando mucho la paliza porque no volví a llamar a Samantha.
cards.back: My friend Kevin is giving me so much grief because I didn't ring Samantha back.

cards.front: Ella lleva meses encima mío para que aprenda a conducir.
cards.back: She's been on my back for months about learning to drive.

cards.front: Yo debería haber sido un poco más pesado con él porque al final suspendió su examen.
cards.back: I should have been on his back more because in the end he failed his exam.

cards.front: Si hubieras sido más pesado con él, habría adornado antes el árbol de Navidad.
cards.back: If you'd been on his back, he would have decorated the tree before Christmas.

cards.front: Te vas a enterar si la casa no está ordenada pronto.
cards.back: I'm going to give you a good hiding if the house isn't tidy soon!

cards.front: Si Max descubriera la verdad, ¡te daría una buena paliza!
cards.back: If Max found out the truth, he would give you such a big hiding!

cards.front: Mi mujer me dio una paliza cuando llegué borracho a casa anoche.
cards.back: My wife gave me a hiding when I got home drunk last night.

cards.front: ¿Por qué quieres saber dónde estoy en todo momento? ¡Déjame en paz!
cards.back: Why do you want to know where I am at every moment? Get off my case!

cards.front: ¡Llevas horas interrogándome! ¿Quieres dejarme en paz?
cards.back: You've been on my case for hours! Will you get off my case?

cards.front: Ella no deja de hacerte preguntas porque no se fía de ti.
cards.back: She won't get off your case because she doesn't trust you.

cards.front: Le dije a él que como siguiera gritándome, haría las maletas y me marcharía.
cards.back: I told him that if he kept on shouting at me, I would pack my bags and leave.

cards.front: Como siga discutiendo él, me hartaré y me marcharé de la sala de reuniones.
cards.back: If he keeps on arguing, I will get tired and leave the meeting room.

cards.front: Él sabe que como siga quejándose, la gente se aburrirá de escucharle.
cards.back: He knows that if he keeps on moaning, people will get bored of listening to him.

cards.front: El médico te dijo que como no dejaras de fumar perjudicarías gravemente tu salud.
cards.back: The doctor told you that if you kept on smoking, you'd seriously damage your health!

cards.front: Como Juan siga bebiendo, perderá a su novia y a todos sus amigos.
cards.back: If John keeps on drinking, he'll lose his girlfriend and all his friends.

cards.front: Como mantengas esa mala postura al sentarte, a largo plazo te convertirás en un jorobado.
cards.back: If you keep on sitting with such bad posture, eventually, you'll turn into a hunchback.

cards.front: Como este coche siga calándose, ¡voy a gritar!
cards.back: If this car keeps on stalling, I'm going to scream!

cards.front: Si el ordenador hubiera seguido apagándose, lo habría tirado por la ventana.
cards.back: If the computer had kept on turning off, I would have chucked it out of the window.

cards.front: Como el motor siga haciendo ese ruido, voy a comprar uno nuevo.
cards.back: If the engine keeps on making that noise, I'm going to buy a new one.

cards.front: Como sigas escapando, nunca llegarás a ser un hombre valiente.
cards.back: If you keep on running away, you will never become a brave man!

cards.front: Como te sigas escondiendo, ¿cómo esperas poder superar tus miedos?
cards.back: If you keep on hiding, how do you expect to conquer your demons?

cards.front: Te prometo que como sigas escondiendo la verdad, a largo plazo saldrá a la luz.
cards.back: I promise that if you keep on hiding the truth, it'll come out eventually.

cards.front: Como sigas siendo un cobarde, la gente va a hablar mal de ti.
cards.back: If you keep on being a coward, people are going to talk negatively about you.

cards.front: Él le advirtió a ella que como siguiera siendo una cobarde, le perdería para siempre.
cards.back: He warned her that if she kept on being a coward, she'd lose him forever.

cards.front: Como sigas siendo un cobarde, no esperes que la gente se enamore de ti.
cards.back: If you keep on being a coward, don't expect people to fall in love with you.

cards.front: Guardo con mucho cuidado el autógrafo original de Napoleón que me regaló un admirador secreto el año pasado.
cards.back: I treasure the original autograph of Napoleon that I was given by a secret admirer last year.

cards.front: ¿Qué libro guardas con más cariño de toda tu extensa colección de primeras ediciones?
cards.back: Which book do you treasure most from your extensive collection of first editions?

cards.front: Hay una fotografía de mí cuando era joven con mi abuelo, de unas vacaciones en Brighton, que guardo con más cariño que cualquier otra.
cards.back: There's one photograph of me when I was young with my grandfather, on holiday in Brighton, that I treasure over all others.

cards.front: El regalo que guardo con más cariño de todos es el dibujo de un caballito de madera que mi sobrina dibujó para mí las Navidades pasadas.
cards.back: The present I cherish above all others is the picture of a rocking horse that my five-year-old niece drew me last Christmas.

cards.front: Guardo con mucho cariño los recuerdos que tengo del primer amor de mi niñez.
cards.back: I cherish the memories I have of my childhood sweetheart.

cards.front: Guardo con mucho cariño el tiempo que pasamos recogiendo moras y retozando en las praderas.
cards.back: I cherish the time we spent blackberry picking and frolicking in the meadows.

cards.front: ¿Cuál de tus pertenencias guardas con más cariño?
cards.back: Which of your belongings do you hold most dearly?

cards.front: Guardo con mucho cariño la colección de teteras antiguas de mi recién fallecida tía-abuela.
cards.back: I hold my late great aunt's collection of antique teapots most dearly.

cards.front: ¿No guardas con cariño la relación por correspondencia con tu amigo canadiense?
cards.back: Don't you hold your friendship with your Canadian pen-pal dearly?

cards.front: Muchas celebridades guardan con recelo su privacidad. Otras aparecen en la revista Hola.
cards.back: Many celebrities guard their privacy with a rod of iron. Others appear in Hello magazine.

cards.front: Todo el mundo tiene el derecho constitucional a guardar silencio en un juicio.
cards.back: Everyone has the constitutional right to guard their silence in a court of law.

cards.front: Protege esta carta con tu vida. Contiene información que podría hacer caer al gobierno.
cards.back: Guard this letter with your life. It contains information which could bring down the government.

cards.front: Julián valora por encima de cualquier otra cosa la copia original y firmada del álbum The Wall que él posee.
cards.back: Julian prizes his original signed copy of the album The Wall above everything else he owns.

cards.front: ¿Qué recuerdo de tu niñez valoras por encima de los otros?
cards.back: Which childhood memory do you prize above all others?

cards.front: Los premios que él valora por encima del resto son los que ganó en natación cuando era adolescente.
cards.back: The prizes he prizes most are the ones he won at swimming when he was a teenager.

cards.front: Es importante mantenerse a la cabeza en lo que concierne a los negocios.
cards.back: It's important to keep ahead of the game as far as business is concerned.

cards.front: Nunca seremos capaces de mantenernos a la cabeza si echamos a otro empleado.
cards.back: We'll never be able to keep ahead if we get rid of another member of staff.

cards.front: ¿Podrás mantenerte a la cabeza si cambian las fechas tope?
cards.back: Will you be able to keep ahead if they change the deadlines?

cards.front: La madre de Jake le castigó sin salir después de cenar por haber dicho una palabrota a su abuela.
cards.back: Jake's mother kept him in after dinner for saying a rude word to his grandmother.

cards.front: ¿Alguna vez te han castigado a quedarte más tarde después de clase por no hacer tus deberes?
cards.back: Have you ever been kept in after school for not doing your homework?

cards.front: Les castigaremos sin salir después de comer si siguen portándose mal.
cards.back: We'll keep them in after lunch if they keep on misbehaving.

cards.front: Yo me llevaría bien con él si fuera tú; su padre es presidente de una multinacional.
cards.back: I would keep in with him if I were you; his father is the president of a multinational.

cards.front: Es esencial que él mantenga una buena relación con la gente adecuada.
cards.back: It's essential that he keep in with the right crowd.

cards.front: ¿Cómo puedes esperar que él mantenga una buena relación con la gente adecuada si nunca estás para vigilarle?
cards.back: How can you expect him to keep in with the right crowd when you're never there to supervise him?

cards.front: Si eres constante con ello el tiempo suficiente, al final le cogerás el truco.
cards.back: If you keep at it for long enough, you'll eventually get the hang of it.

cards.front: Lo difícil no es empezar; lo difícil es ser constante.
cards.back: The difficult part is not starting; the difficult part is keeping at it.

cards.front: ¡Voy a seguir con ello aunque acabe conmigo!
cards.back: I'm going to keep at it even if it kills me!

cards.front: Te agradecería que pudieras mantenerlo en secreto por ahora.
cards.back: I'd be very grateful if you could keep it under wraps for the time being.

cards.front: Es vital mantener todos tus datos empresariales bajo llave.
cards.back: It's vital to keep all your business data under lock and key.

cards.front: Tendremos a todos los sospechosos bajo vigilancia hasta que encontremos más pruebas.
cards.back: We're keeping all the suspects under surveillance until we can find some more evidence.

cards.front: Vigila a Layla. Ahora que está aprendiendo a andar puede alcanzar objetos peligrosos.
cards.back: Keep an eye on Layla; now that she's a toddler, she can reach dangerous objects.

cards.front: No hace falta que le vigiles a él. Sabe lo que está haciendo.
cards.back: There's no need for you to keep an eye on him. He knows what he's doing.

cards.front: ¡Vigilad los cielos! ¡Vienen los extraterrestres!
cards.back: Keep an eye on the sky! The aliens are coming!

cards.front: Debiste haber estado atento a ese coche. Ahora ya se ha ido el agente a casa.
cards.back: You should have kept an eye out for that car. Now the agent has gone home.

cards.front: Estate atento a un hombre con un maletín marrón. Él te dirá lo que tienes que hacer.
cards.back: Keep your eye out for a tall man with a brown briefcase. He will tell you what you have to do.

cards.front: Necesito estar atento al mismo abrigo que tiene Miranda.
cards.back: I need to keep an eye out for the same coat that Miranda has.

cards.front: Si le mantienes alerta, su comportamiento cambiará.
cards.back: If you keep him on his toes, his behaviour will change.

cards.front: Estos alumnos son muy astutos y se aburrirán fácilmente. ¡Manténles controlados!
cards.back: These students are very sharp and they get bored easily. Keep them on their toes!

cards.front: El entrenador no nos mantenía en tensión durante el entrenamiento y al final perdimos.
cards.back: The coach didn't keep us on our toes during training and we lost in the end.

cards.front: Sé que te estás preocupando, ¡pero cálmate! No hay nada que puedas hacer en este momento.
cards.back: I know you're worrying, but keep your hair on! There's nothing you can do right now.

cards.front: Estaba tan enfadada que tuve que decirle que se calmase.
cards.back: She was so angry that I had to tell her to keep her hair on.

cards.front: ¡Cálmate! Cuanto más te estreses, ¡más nervioso me pondrás!
cards.back: Keep your hair on! The more stressed you get, the more nervous you'll make me!

cards.front: Sé que ella te dejó, ¡pero anímate! Es hora de pasar página.
cards.back: I know that she left you, but keep your chin up! It's time to move on.

cards.front: Le dije la semana pasada que se animara, pero creo que le gusta ser negativo.
cards.back: I told him last week to keep his chin up, but I think he likes being negative.

cards.front: Si te animas, te prometo que desprenderás mejores vibraciones.
cards.back: If you keep your chin up, I promise you will give off better vibes.

cards.front: Mantén el pico cerrado sobre tu reciente oferta de trabajo hasta que hables con tu jefe.
cards.back: Keep mum about your new job offer until you have a chance to talk to your boss.

cards.front: Él debería mantener el pico cerrado sobre lo que vio si quiere salir con vida de Nueva Jersey.
cards.back: He should keep mum about what he saw if he wants to get out of New Jersey alive.

cards.front: Más te vale mantener el pico cerrado si sabes lo que te conviene.
cards.back: You'd better keep mum if you know what's good for you.

cards.front: Frank, por favor, mantén a Jane al tanto de la evolución de este proyecto.
cards.back: Frank, please keep Jane posted on how this project develops.

cards.front: ¡Por todos los santos, mantenedme al tanto de los resultados del partido!
cards.back: For heaven's sake, keep me posted on the match scores!

cards.front: ¡Te mantendré al tanto sobre si él me llama o no!
cards.back: I'll keep you posted about whether he calls me or not!

cards.front: Mantened al director general informado de todos los cambios que hagáis.
cards.back: Keep the CEO abreast of all the changes you make.

cards.front: Él me dijo que le mantuviéramos informado de cualquier decisión que tomáramos.
cards.back: He told me to keep him abreast of whatever decision we made.

cards.front: Si no mantengo a mi tía informada del día a día de mi vida, no duerme bien por la noche.
cards.back: If I don't keep my aunt abreast of my day-to-day life, she doesn't sleep well at night.

cards.front: Él intentó mantener mis miedos alejados contándome sus propias experiencias.
cards.back: He tried to keep my fears at bay by telling me about his own experiences.

cards.front: Si les damos a nuestros acreedores un 10% de lo que les debemos, puede que eso les mantenga alejados.
cards.back: If we give the creditors 10% of what we owe them, maybe that will keep them at bay.

cards.front: Si quieres mantener alejada a la competencia, siempre tienes que estar un paso por delante.
cards.back: If you want to keep the competition at bay, you always have to be one step ahead.

cards.front: Lo más importante en una entrevista de trabajo es mantener la calma.
cards.back: The most important thing at a job interview is to keep your cool.

cards.front: Estaba muy nervioso por hablar delante de toda aquella gente, pero al final mantuve la calma.
cards.back: I was very nervous to speak in front of all those people, but in the end I kept my cool.

cards.front: ¡Ella mantuvo la calma cuando el camarero le trajo bacalao en vez de merluza aunque estuvo a punto de perder el control!
cards.back: She kept her cool when the waiter brought her cod instead of hake even though she was about to lose it!
